skill.name: set-up-cloudflare-google-ads-enhanced-conversions
skill.description: Set up and troubleshoot Google Ads Enhanced Conversions for a Cloudflare storefront using Product Metrics. Check tracking readiness, consent settings, and Google Ads customer data terms.
skill.summary: Check and configure Google Ads Enhanced Conversions for a Cloudflare storefront.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags describe Markdown, documentation links, or routine setup checks; no audit-directed prompt injection was found. Real risks include unpinned installation, broad Cloudflare permission guidance, access to order data, and weak limits on credentials and setup changes. The documentation conflicts on which customer fields are sent and does not verify whether consent controls the payload.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer to a reviewed version and the skill source to an immutable revision. Present installation as a separate action that requires user approval.
List each required permission, its purpose, and the target zone. Tell users to stop if the approval screen shows any unexpected permission or account.

remediation.issue: Order access exceeds the verification task
remediation.suggestion: Use the purchase status or one known test order by default. Require authorization for production order reads, and omit margin and customer status unless requested.
Remove the credential exceptions from this workflow. Use browser authorization or a secure secret entry flow that keeps credentials out of prompts and command arguments.

remediation.issue: Setup can expand beyond the requested change
remediation.suggestion: Name Product Metrics and show the target account, property, and proposed changes. Require approval before adding tracking or configuring another destination.
Verify the live Cloudflare payload and align the skill description, field table, and consent guidance with the same list of fields and destinations.

remediation.issue: Test order does not verify consent enforcement
remediation.suggestion: Use synthetic orders for both granted and denied ad user data consent. Verify field presence or absence without printing raw identifiers or hashes.

semantic_findings.title: Unrelated Exceptions Permit Direct Handling of Secrets
semantic_findings.description: The rules let the agent collect credentials for other platforms and pass them to commands. None of these credentials is needed for this Cloudflare and Google Ads workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The rule explicitly permits receiving and passing secrets for Lightspeed, Meta, and OpenAI. It forbids logging but does not specify a secure input channel.

semantic_findings.title: Prerequisite Setup Can Expand the Authorized Scope
semantic_findings.description: The skill invokes Product Metrics even when the user does not name it. It directs the agent to set up missing tracking and links a guide that also covers other ad destinations.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Browser approval is manual, but the prerequisite rule does not require separate approval before broadening setup beyond Google Ads Enhanced Conversions.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Disclosure of Customer Data Fields
semantic_findings.description: The skill description says it sends hashed email, phone, and name. The Cloudflare field table says only email is available for matching, which makes the stated data scope unreliable.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The field table expressly lists phone and name as unavailable. This proves the disclosure conflict, not that those fields are transmitted.

semantic_findings.title: Purchase Receipt Does Not Verify Consent Enforcement
semantic_findings.description: The workflow uses a banner selection check and a test purchase receipt. Neither check shows which customer fields are sent when a visitor grants or denies consent.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guide states that its test proves only purchase arrival. It describes behavior when consent is denied but does not test that behavior.

content.user_title: Set Up Google Ads Enhanced Conversions on Cloudflare
content.value_statement: Google Ads can miss purchases when cookies alone cannot link them to ad clicks. Use Product Metrics to check consent settings and configure Enhanced Conversions for a Cloudflare storefront.
actual_capabilities: Read setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP server.
Identify missing Cloudflare or Google Ads connections and server-side conversion actions.
Guide users through selecting the supported consent banner their storefront uses.
Show a Google Ads administrator where to accept customer data terms and recheck Data Manager readiness.
Guide a test purchase and distinguish order receipt from Google Ads matching.
limitations: You need Product Metrics Pro, a proxied Cloudflare storefront, linked Merchant Center, and live server-side Google Ads tracking.
An authorized person must complete account approvals, accept Google terms, and change primary conversion actions.
The Cloudflare guide documents hashed email only for customer matching, and only when the site supplies it and the visitor allows ad user data.
The purchase check confirms order receipt only. It does not verify identifier delivery, consent enforcement, or ad attribution.

use_cases.title: Check storefront readiness
use_cases.description: Find the setup steps your Cloudflare store still needs before you ask an administrator to enable Enhanced Conversions.

use_cases.title: Clear a Google Ads readiness error
use_cases.description: Identify whether customer data terms or Data Manager acceptance blocks setup in the client or manager account.

use_cases.title: Verify test purchase receipt
use_cases.description: Check whether a test purchase arrived and document which consent and attribution checks are still outstanding.

prompt_templates.title: List the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List the requirements for Enhanced Conversions on my Cloudflare storefront. Tell me which steps require an administrator.

prompt_templates.title: Review tracking status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the status for my Product Metrics storefront and Google Ads property. Tell me which steps are complete and make no changes.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Data Manager rejection
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me distinguish missing customer data terms from a Data Manager rejection. Show me where to check in Google Ads without changing my settings.

prompt_templates.title: Review consent and test purchase evidence
prompt_templates.scenario: An integration is ready for validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the configured consent banner and confirm receipt of my test order. Explain which checks still need to verify consent enforcement and Google Ads attribution. Do not read production orders or show customer identifiers.

output_examples.input: Why does Enhanced Conversions show Action required?
output: Customer data terms are not accepted in the connected Google Ads account.
Ask a Google Ads administrator to review the terms, then select Re-check in Product Metrics.

output_examples.input: Did my test order confirm Enhanced Conversions?
output: The test purchase appears under Last purchase received.
This confirms receipt by Product Metrics, not consent enforcement or a match in Google Ads.

best_practices: Verify the Cloudflare zone and Google Ads client account before approving any connection.
Confirm the configured consent banner matches the one visitors see on the storefront.
Use a test order and limit the status report to the information needed to confirm receipt.
anti_patterns: Approve permissions for an unexpected Cloudflare zone or ad account.
Share API tokens, customer emails, or order records in chat.
Treat a received test purchase as proof that Google Ads matched it to an ad click.

faq.question: Does this replace server-side conversion tracking?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics server-side tracking to Google Ads must be active before you check Enhanced Conversions.

faq.question: Do I need to add a Google tag?
faq.answer: No. The documented Cloudflare Tracking workflow sends conversions through Google Data Manager without adding a Google tag.

faq.question: Which customer fields can Google Ads receive for matching?
faq.answer: The Cloudflare guide documents hashed email when the site provides it and the visitor allows ad user data. It does not list phone or name as available.

faq.question: What happens if ad user data consent is denied?
faq.answer: The guide says Google Ads can still receive the purchase without hashed email if the visitor allows ad storage. With neither permission, the purchase is not sent.

faq.question: Who can accept the customer data terms?
faq.answer: A Google Ads administrator must review and accept the terms. Use the manager account if Product Metrics says that account manages the terms.

faq.question: Does this skill change bidding or set up Customer Match?
faq.answer: No. Bidding and Customer Match use separate workflows. The skill leaves primary conversion choices to the user.
